# runzero_task (Data Source)

Fetches a single RunZero task by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of the task.

### Read-Only

- `agent_id` (String) The agent ID executing the task.
- `created_at` (Number) Creation timestamp (Unix epoch).
- `created_by` (String) The user who created the task.
- `description` (String) The description of the task.
- `error` (String) Error message if the task failed.
- `hidden` (Boolean) Whether the task is hidden.
- `hosted_zone_id` (String) The hosted zone ID executing the task.
- `name` (String) The name of the task.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization ID.
- `recur` (Boolean) Whether the task recurs.
- `recur_frequency` (String) Recurrence frequency (e.g. hourly).
- `recur_last` (Number) Last recurrence timestamp (Unix epoch).
- `recur_next` (Number) Next recurrence timestamp (Unix epoch).
- `site_id` (String) The site ID the task belongs to.
- `start_time` (Number) Start time timestamp (Unix epoch).
- `status` (String) The status of the task.
- `template_id` (String) The scan template ID.
- `type` (String) The type of the task (e.g. scan).
- `updated_at` (Number) Last update timestamp (Unix epoch).
